LESSON: READING 4.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING – SHORT STORIES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are short stories important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary from texts on the theme for language acquisition
2. use vocabulary related to the theme for sentence construction

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 4.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING – SHORT STORIES
This lesson teaches Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vocabulary from texts on the theme for language acquisition
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use vocabulary related to the theme for sentence construction
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories above.
2. Explain Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are short stories important?
2. Why is it important to ensure safety in your environment and especially roads?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary from texts on the theme for language acquisition
2. use vocabulary related to the theme for sentence construction

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
